overall_reason: The exports window is untinted greys on white with one green dot on the 'Export complete' toast, but it uses five text greys and a toast with both an edge ring and a drop shadow.

score.reason: T-ACCENT-DOSAGE passes (one green dot for the done state), while T-PALETTE-ROLES finds five text greys on one ground and T-SURFACE-LADDER finds border plus shadow on the toast.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.where: window text (titles, meta, 'Ready' states, window title 'Exports'), 1440, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P52\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table finds 5 text levels on the white ground: #333333 (1), #444444 (4), #555555 (1), #888888 (5) and #999999 (6).
findings.after: Three text greys: ink, secondary and meta; merge #333333 to #555555 into one ink and #888888 with #999999 into one meta step
findings.why: Steps of 7 to 10 per cent lightness are too close to read as roles and drift from one component to the next.

findings.title: A card has a border or a shadow
findings.evidence: The palette table lists one border-plus-shadow element: box-shadow 'rgba(0,0,0,0.11) 0 3px 12px' with a 1px #e8e8e8 ring; the window uses a second recipe 'rgba(0,0,0,0.043) 0 4px 14px'.
findings.before: Toast with a 1px ring and a drop shadow; a second shadow recipe on the window
findings.after: The toast lifted by one shadow recipe shared with the window, with no ring
findings.why: Two edge treatments on one small surface add noise without adding separation.

strengths: The green dot is the only hue and marks the done state on the toast.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
